name: Wayward Distillery Depth Charge Nocino
description:
Depth Charge Nocino begins with a single walnut tree on Denman Island, a quiet old giant that has shaded families for years and still drops a generous crop each summer. When the walnuts are green and full of aroma, we gather them by hand and steep them in our dark and dry Depth Charge spirit. The base carries natural notes of coffee and cacao with a small amount of honey to bring everything together.

As the walnuts infuse, the spirit grows deeper in flavour. The green husks add earthy tannins and a hint of resin, and the roasted character of Depth Charge develops into something richer. Aromas of walnut, orange peel, nutmeg, coffee, and burnt sugar rise from the glass. A touch of honey offers balance without adding sweetness.

 

30% ABV

name: Synchromesh 2022 Storm Haven Boulders Block Riesling
description:
Grown in heavy clay soils, filled with granit boulders, over a sublayer of sandy gravels.  This wine presents with a fuller body, high acidity, and dry finish. 

Baked pie apple, lime zest with a broad mouthfeel and weight.

name: Unsworth Cuvée de l'Île 2019
description:
Cuvée de l'île is crafted in the traditional method. 2019 Unsworth Vineyard Cuvée de l'île is Pinot Gris (87%), Chardonnay (13%)  The wine is lees aged in tank and for a further 36 months in bottle before hand riddling and disgorgement. Following a minimal Brut Nature style dosage, the wine was aged for a further year before release.

 

The wine shows toasty notes of nuts and fresh brioche supported by apple and lemon. Cuvée de l’île is a wine of passion and made in very small quantities. It is bone-dry, poised and showcases Unsworth’s meticulous attention to detail.

Fortified (Port Style) red wine, crafted from estate-grown Cobble Hill Castel, hillside fruit. This wine displays a captivating deep ruby color with hints of purple. The nose enchants with aromas of black currant, ripe raspberry, exotic spices, and toasted vanilla beans.  On the palate, experience a richly textured blend of dark blackberries, plum, cinnamon, and freshly baked graham cracker pie crust. description:
Saison Vineyard Pinot Noir

A snapshot of a special place to grow Pinot Noir. This wine is complex and full of dark cherry and floral notes with undercurrents of earthy complexity. Saison Pinot Noir is one of our favourite wines from grape to glass.

name: Macaloney's The Peat Project: Ex-Bourbon Cask, Islay Peat
description:
Macaloney’s first ever peated single malt with Islay peat!

 

From the ‘peated’ single malt range, this island whisky undergoes double distillation using traditional Scottish methods, uses only the finest local malted barley and is uniquely peat-smoked at the distillery – a practice exclusive to a select few. The patient, purposeful distillation yields a complex, layered, and balanced ‘clearach’ (new-make spirit).

 

The Peat Project range allows you to explore how peats from Washington USA, Canada, and now for the first time; Scotland, differ in their unique flavour profiles.

 

This expression was distilled using local barley peat-smoked at our distillery to 54 ppm with Scottish peat traditionally hand-cut on the island of Islay. It was then fully matured in a carefully selected Bourbon cask,blanketed with fresh maritime island air.

 

Nose: Lightly medicinal leading to fruit & floral notes. The most notable early presence includes juniper, pine, treacle and hazelnut. Finishing to dark fruit cake, freshly brewed coffee, delicate pipe smoke and fresh sea breeze.

 

Palate: Velvety with vanilla pods, blackberry jam, and fresh blackcurrents with hints of sweet peat smoke. The Islay peat presents as iodine, seaweed, dried tobacco leaf and leather. Sourdough and malted milk yield to clover honey and then finishes with dried ginger and cellared oak casks.

 

54 PPM

ABV: 46%

Natural Colour & Non-Chill Filtered

name: Macaloney's Siol Dugall
description:
Siol Dugall, our Whiskymaker’s medium peated signature expression was married from a select combination of Kentucky Bourbon casks, virgin American casks, and re-charred Portuguese red wine barriques. The nose is superb with pine wood smoke, light peat smoke and tropical fruit, pork scratchings, rosemary, cedar, sandal wood, and lapsang souchong tea, developing to rose petals, dates, lemon zest, and butterscotch with hints of nutmeg, cloves and ginger. There are also summer meadow flowers, fresh cut grass, malt extract and burnt heather. The palate has a velvety mouthfeel with sweet malty peat smoke, barley water, sweetpea flowers, clover honey, crème brûlée with burnt caramel, fennel seed, lemon sponge cake, and dried hay, with lingering oak, a light sweet smoke finish, and a hint of salt with ocean breeze.

 

27 PPM

ABV: 46%

Natural Colour & Non-Chill Filtered

name: Macaloney's An Loy
description:
An Loy, formerly known as Glenloy, is our ‘Whiskymaker’s Signature Selection’ whereby we carefully selected our classic single malt whisky from a combination of 60% first use Bourbon casks for a delicate, clean presentation, 15% from Dr. Swans wonderful Portuguese STR red-wine barriques for pronounced oak and sweet red-berry contribution, and 15% Oloroso / 10% PX Spanish Sherry casks for wonderful, rich and delicate fruit cake and plums. Together they compliment the tropical fruits and creamy presentation of our new-make house style (which garnered a Gold Medal at the prestigious World Whiskies Awards) to create fruit, floral and Sherry notes followed with oak, vanilla, malt, and sea breeze on the nose. On the palate, creamy, caramelized orange, vanilla, potpourri, fruit cake, blackcurrant, honey, wood spices, and lingering oak.

 

ABV: 46%

Natural Colour & Non-Chill Filtered

name: Macaloney's Kildara
description:
This island whisky is from our triple distilled single potstill range – triple distilled using only the best unmalted and malted barley available. Kildara was married from a select combination of Kentucky Bourbon, Spanish Oloroso, virgin American, and Spanish Pedro Ximénez (PX) casks. The result is a full bodied, triple distilled single potstill, island whisky with pronounced Oloroso and PX notes including dried fruit cake, vanilla crème laced with cinnamon, demerara sugar, and old seasoned leather notes. Abundant tropical fruits include candied orange, dried apricot, figs, ripe blackberries, blackcurrant jam, dried raisins and roasted nuts. The complexity continues with barley, malt and dried hay, butterscotch, milk chocolate, light tobacco and ocean breeze.

 

ABV: 46%

Natural Colour & Non-Chill Filtered

name: Macaloney's Cath Nah Aven
description:
Cath-Nah-Aven is our salute to the great Sherried whiskies from the banks of the river Spey. This award-winning Vancouver Island distilled classic single malt spirit was carefully matured in premium Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez casks from Andalucía in Spain. This whisky is carefully selected from a range of  American (Quercus alba) oak casks. These were married by our Whiskymaker to create a complex red-berry, plum, and oak nose that compliments and enhances the fruit and floral notes of our new-make spirit.

 

ABV: 57%

The palate is smooth and creamy with tropical fruits, fruit cake, honey, citrus, dark chocolate, juicy malt, a hint of sea salt, emerging spices and a long oak finish.

description: Storm Haven Vineyard is the 107-acre home and heart of Synchromesh. Farmed without synthetics or chemicals and following a holistic approach, we strive to grow our vines within the existing ecosystem rather than manipulating it. All this is supported by a 65 acre sanctuary to protect the sensitive habitat that calls our property home.

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2024 Muscat
description: With star-bright clarity and medium straw hue, accented by a delicate fern green tint at the rim. The nose offers a whiplash-inducing intensity of jasmine, lychee, and lemon verbena, inviting you to indulge from the first sniff. On the palate, these vibrant aromatics are joined by honeydew melon and a touch of savory texture from whole cluster pressing. Medium-bodied with delicate acidity, this Muscat finishes steely and clean, promising a truly memorable tasting experience. Harvested from Zanatta Vineyard.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Vancouver Island; White; Wine

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2024 Rosé
description: A vibrant and refreshing wine that captures the essence of summer in every sip. Crafted from 63% Zweigelt from Cherry Point Vineyard and 37% Cabernet Libre from our Estate Vineyard, this star-bright Rosé delights the nose with tantalizing notes of watermelon, Rainier cherry, and gooseberry. Enjoy a hint of spritz crackle on the palate, followed by flavors of red currant, watermelon, and cherries, with bright acidity and a touch of savory herb. Basket pressed and aged in stainless steel; this well-balanced, medium-light-bodied wine has a satisfying finishing length.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Vancouver Island; Wine; Rosé

name: Nagging Doubt 2022 Cabernet Sauvignon
description:
100% Cabernet Sauvignon from the Okanagan Valley.  Aged 20 months in first-pass French and American oak.

 

This Cabernet Sauvignon showcases vibrant, classic aromas of dark, juicy berriesand a hint of graphite that adds an extra layer of complexity to the nose and palate. Thewine's tannins, structure, and long finish make it an age-worthy vintage (5-7 years).

name: Mt. Boucherie White Label 2023 Riesling
description:
Our Riesling was planted in 1991 at Lazy River Vineyard in South Cawston, Similkameen Valley.

 

This wine showcases ripe citrus and stone fruit characteristics with hallmark bright acidity and freshness. Pair with oysters, spicy prawns, or glazed pork belly.

 

12% Alcohol
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; White; Wine

name: 1 Mill Road 2024 Grenache Rosé
description:
100% Grenache Rosé is sourced from Coyote Canyon Vineyard in Washington's Horse Heaven Hills AVA.

 

Pale salmon hue, the 2024 Grenache Rosé is both delicate and expressive.  The nose opens with notes of blood orange, pink cherry and chalky strawberry, lifted by a hint of sea spray.  

 

The palate is bone dry and precise, with bright red strawberry and raspberry layered over stunning acidity.

 

12.4% Alcohol

name: Rust Wines 2020 Solus - Golden Mile Bench
description:
38% Merlot, 32% Zinfandel, 29% Cabernet Sauvignon, 1% Gewürztraminer from the South Rock Vineyard on Golden Mile Bench

 

Aged for 18 months in French and American oak, 61% of which was new.

 

As each block is harvested, it is added to the cuvée as part of a rolling cofermentation. The ethos of this process is intended to put forth a unified expression of a single vineyard site

name: Rust Wines 2022 Zinfandel - Golden Mile Bench
description:
100% Zinfandel from the South Rock Vineyard on Golden Mile Bench

 

Aged in a combination of French and Hungarian oak, 13% of which was new.

 

Showcasing brambly fruit, clove, dried cherries, and figs. A thread of baking spice persists through the palate, which finishes with lingering notes of both fresh, dried, and compote-like red fruit.

name: Rust Wines 2022 Syrah - Okanagan Falls
description:
100% Syrah from the Lost Horn Vineyard in Okanagan Falls

 

25% whole-cluster fermented. Aged in French & Hungarian oak for 18 months, 33% of
which was new.

 

Our second release of Syrah from Okanagan Falls offers a structured and full-bodied wine with a brooding, rustic quality. Vibrant purple fruit, leather, subtle spice, and fresh-cut violets complement this wine's inherent depth. Rather shy in its youth, expect this to open up increasingly over the next 5 years.

name: Rust Wines 2022 Syrah - Golden Mile Bench
description:
100% Syrah from the South Rock Vineyard on the Golden Mile Bench.

 

Aged in French oak for approximately 18 months, 25% of which was new

 

Damson plum, brambleberry, and garrigue dominate the nose and palate, complemented by hallmark Syrah-like cured meat character. Look for this to develop for the next 8-10 years.

name: Rust Wines 2022 Pinot Noir - West Kelowna
description:
100% Pinot Noir from the Three Mountain Vineyard in West Kelowna

 

Aged in French & Hungarian oak for 16 months, 20% of which was new.

 

Pronounced cherry fruit, subtle earthiness, dense brush, and layered tea spice all play their respective roles in an elegant frame.

name: Rust Wines 2022 Gamay - Similkameen Valley
description:
100% Gamay from the Lazy River Vineyard, Similkameen Valley

Bursting with crunchy red berries, bing cherry, and the subtlest of mineral and tobacco notes

name: Rust Wines 2022 Cabernet Franc - Okanagan Falls

100% Cabernet Franc from the Lost Horn Vineyard, in Okanagan Falls

 

The 2022 Cabernet Franc is bursting with juicy, fresh red and purple fruits, a hint of pepper spice.

 

6 months in neutral French & European oak.

name: Rust Wines 2023 Riesling - Okanagan Falls
description:
100% Riesling from Lost Horn Vineyards in Okanagan Falls.

 

Bright acidity with layered fruit, beginning with classic lime and honeyed green apple notes leading to lashings of guava and papaya. Well-balanced and genuinely mouthwatering.

 

100% stainless steel fermented with 5 months on the lees.

name: 1 Mill Road 2023 Block Two Pinot Noir
description: This wine is produced from Black Pine Vineyard, a 4-acre slice of paradise on the Naramata Bench. The Pinot Noir portion of the vineyard is planted to four clones. The vines grow and thrive in granite soil that is bony and dry, forcing the vines to struggle just enough to encourage deep complexity in flavour. These grapes were hand-picked and gently crushed and destemmed into stainless steel fermenters. Fermentation lasted 14 days, utilizing a combination of cap management techniques. After fermentation, the wine was drained and gently basket-pressed into a mix of 1-, 2-, and 3-year-old French oak barriques. After nine months, the wine was blended and bottled, unfined and unfiltered.

name: Rust Wines 2023 Chardonnay - Okanagan Falls
description:
100% Chardonnay from Lost Horn Vineyards in Okanagan Falls.

 

Our second release of barrel-fermented Chardonnay, made in the Burgundian "black" style, during which the grapes are aggressively pressed and exposed to relatively greater amounts of oxygen before spontaneous fermentation in barrel. This process
adds a layer of complexity and in turn, makes the wine more cellar-worthy. White peach and shiro plum are complemented by delicate notes of caramel,

name: Synchromesh 2023 Long's View Dry Riesling
description: The former Bob Hancock Vineyard has been renamed for the current owners Charles and Linda Long. Returning to vineyard ownership after many years, the Long’s have committed to a fully organic transition of this property as we nurture it into maturity. Located up above the Naramata Village on an alluvial fan of mostly calcium carbonate, the gentle southern slope provides very even and balanced ripening with great acid retention and gentle structure.

name: Mt. Boucherie Original Vines PTG 2021
description: This field blend of Pinot Noir, Gamay Noir, and Pinot Gris were crushed in to tank  together where they underwent full Carbonic Maceration (natural fermentation under a blanket of CO2). This technique provides a fresh, fruit- forward, and lighter style red wine. It then spent 6 months in second-use French oak puncheons where the various components were able to fully integrate, creating a polished, intentional example of the style.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Okanagan

name: Mt. Boucherie Original Vines 2022 Chardonnay
description:
All of the vineyard blocks chosen for the Original Vines Collection were planted before the year 2000.

 

100% Chardonnay.  Delicate notes of orchard fruit, almond, and a kiss of oak are met with a line of fresh, citrus-tinted acidity. Notes of lemon, peach, and orange blossom fill the glass while the palate showcases pineapple, fresh bread, and a hint French oak spice.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; White; Wine; Okanagan

name: Mt. Boucherie Original Vines Cabernet Sauvignon 2021
description:
All of the vineyard blocks chosen for the Original Vines Collection were planted before the year 2000.

 

Dark, opulent fruit backed by present yet ripe tannins, with a pleasing, sumptuous, and persistent finish.

 

Aged for 18 months (60% French oak and 40% American oak, 40% of which was new)
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Okanagan

name: Mt. Boucherie Original Vines 2022 Sémillon
description:
All of the vineyard blockschosen for the Original Vines Collection were planted before the year 2000.

 

A rich, yet acid-driven style that will continue to age for 8+ years.

 

Notes of beeswax, yellow peach, and fig fill the glass while the palate is full of mandarin-laden citrus framed by a kiss of French oak.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Wine; White

name: Mt. Boucherie White Label Cabernet Merlot
description: Our Cabernet Merlot is blended from vineyards in the Okanagan and Similkameen Valleys. These areas impart their distinctive stamp on the finished wine, which showcases flavours of plum, blackberries, lavender, and mocha. Medium to full-bodied, aged 14 months in neutral French oak.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Red; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie White Label 2022 Merlot
description: A medium to full-bodied Merlot that showcases aromas and flavours of black cherry, clove, and red berry compote. Aged in French oak for 14 months, 15% of which was new.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Red; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie White Label 2023 Blaufränkisch 2023
description:
Our Blaufränkisch was planted in 1993 at Lazy River Vineyard in South Cawston, Similkameen Valley.

Aged in neutral Hungarian and French oak for 4 months.

A rare and unique medium-bodied wine that showcases notes of wild blueberries, sour cherries, and baking spices.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Red; Okanagan; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie White Label 2024 Pinot Noir
description:
100% Pinot Noir. Aged in French oak for 6 months, 15% new.

This medium-bodied wine shows classic notes of fresh and vibrant Bing cherry, cranberry compote, subtle spice, with the complexity of fine black tea.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Red; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie White Label 2024 Rosé
description:
Gamay Noir,  cultivated at Featherstone Vineyard, Niagara Peninsula, Ontario.

 

A mouthwatering rosé with aromas and flavours of watermelon, raspberry, and citrus blossom. Bright and eminently refreshing , it pairs wonderfully with charcuterie, summer salads, and patios.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Rosé; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie White Label 2024 Pinot Gris
description:
100% Pinot Gris, cultivated in Yakima Valley, AVA Washington State.

 

Clean, bright, with delicate citrus and stone fruit notes, this is a Pinot Gris that feels close to home.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; White; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie Reserve Malbec 2022
description: Our 2021 Reserve Malbec was farmed at Lazy River Vineyard in South Cawston, Similkameen Valley.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Red; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie Reserve Merlot 2021
description:
Our 2021 Reserve Merlot was farmed at Lazy River Vineyard in South Cawston, South Rock Vineyard on the Golden Mile Bench, and Lost Horn Vineyard in Okanagan Falls.

 

100% Merlot

Aged in American and French oakfor 14 months, 25% of which was new.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Red; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie Reserve Chardonnay 2023
description:
A full-bodied Chardonnay showing aromas and flavours of peach, pineapple,
Meyer lemon, and oak spice. Rich seafood dishes or roasted white meats are perfect pairings.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; White; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie Reserve Syrah 2022
description: Our 2020 Reserve Syrah was farmed at Lazy River Vineyard in the Similkameen Valley, as well as South Rock Vineyard on the Golden Mile Bench and Lost Horn Vineyard in Okanagan Falls.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Red; Wine

name: Mt. Boucherie Summit (Meritage) 2019
description:
Varieties:

57% Merlot, 26% Cabernet Franc, 9% Carménère, 5% Malbec, 2% Cabernet Sauvignon, 1% Syrah
Appellation: British Columbia BC VQA
Cellar: Aged in 100% French oak for 24 months, 35% of which was new.
collection: Mt. Boucherie Estate Winery; Okanagan; Red; Wine

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2023 Muscat
description: Our 2023 Muscat captivates the senses with its star-bright clarity and medium straw hue, accented by a delicate fern green tint at the rim. The nose offers a whiplash inducing intensity of jasmine, lychee, and lemon verbena, inviting you to indulge from the first sniff. On the palate, these vibrant aromatics are joined by honeydew melon and a touch of savory texture from whole cluster pressing. Medium-bodied with delicate acidity, this Muscat finishes steely and clean, promising a truly memorable tasting experience. Harvested from Zanatta Vineyard.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Vancouver Island; White; Wine

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2023 Merlot
description: This wine captivates with its clear, day-bright clarity and deep ruby color, edged with pale purple. On the nose, it enchants with gorgeous aromas of damson plum, dark rose petals, cassis, and a hint of fresh-cut cedar. The palate is rich with loads of black cherry up front, followed by notes of bergamot tea and cacao nibs. Medium-plus bodied with youthful tannins, this Merlot features juicy acidity and a touch of pomegranate on the finish.  Grown at Zanatta Vineyards.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Red; Vancouver Island; Wine

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2023 Estate Castel
description: Castel is a French-American hybrid of Cinsault x V. rupestris, sustainably farmed and estate-grown since its planting in 2006. This "ink grade" wine showcases an incredible depth of color, with an inky purple, nearly opaque midnight black hue. Castel underwent a 30% whole cluster fermentation to enrich the mid-palate structure, adding hints of black pepper to its complex profile. On the nose, dense layers of dark plums, freshly cracked black pepper, and a nostalgic hint of Flintstone vitamins invite you to indulge. The palate reveals sun-warmed blackberries, Santa Rosa plum, and clove, complemented by a dash of dark chocolate. This full-bodied wine offers a rich expression of ripe, hillside fruit, balanced acidity, and soft, well-integrated tannins, culminating in a long, complex finish.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Red; Vancouver Island; Wine

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2023 Zweigelt
description: With a brilliant, star-bright clarity and a pale straw color with hints of green chartreuse at the edges, this Austrian variety thrives in our local microclimate, offering a vibrant blend of exotic aromas and flavors. The lush medium-deep ruby color with brilliant clarity beckons the eye, while the nose presents a spicy blend of pink and Szechuan peppercorns intertwined with enticing notes of blood orange and cranberry. On the palate, this fruit-forward and juicy wine bursts with tart cherry, pomegranate, blood orange, and spice. A lovely mid-palate texture, mouthwatering acidity, and moderately solid tannins lead to a long, intense finish with good intensity. Aged in a mix of neutral French oak and stainless steel, this wine's nuanced aromas and flavors are both enhanced and preserved.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Vancouver Island; Rosé; Wine

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2024 Pinot Gris "Rouge"
description:
Our 2024 Skin Fermented Pinot Gris is an intriguing and captivating wine. It sparkles with star-like clarity and a pale garnet hue. Featuring wild alpine strawberries, black raspberry, and struck flint, with a subtle hint of wild fennel and saffron on the nose. The palate opens with a snap of tart fruit, leading to the taste of Mirabelle plums grilled over hardwood coals, and finishes with lingering strawberries. Its refreshing acidity and a fine band of firm tannins create a balanced, light-bodied wine with good tension. Initially intended as a direct-press white wine, fate intervened, inspiring us to
showcase the beautiful color of the Pinot Gris grapes. The result is a stunning light red wine that fully captures the essence of the varietal.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Vancouver Island; White; Wine

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2022 Pinot Gris
description:
Gently basket-pressed and fermented in stainless steel, this medium-bodied wine offers a harmonious acidity. In the glass, it shines with star-bright clarity and a medium straw hue touched with copper. The nose reveals light citrus notes mingled with honeysuckle, chamomile, and forest rain. On the palate, experience flavors of white peach, tart Granny Smith apple, and green almond, all supported by bright, snappy acidity and a crisp core. The finish is clean with a whisper of grape-skin
phenols.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Vancouver Island; White; Wine

name: Cobble Hill Winery 2023 Kismet White Blend
description:
With a brilliant, star-bright clarity and a pale straw color with hints of green chartreuse at the edges, Kismet captivates at first glance. The nose reveals tightly packed aromas of lime zest, citrus blossom, quince, and a touch of white peach, showcasing the vibrant Albariño, Sauvignon Blanc, Viognier, and Bacchus varietals.

 

On the palate, experience lip-smacking acidity with flavors of key lime, mint, pineapple, and white ginger, creating a super racy, lean, and edgy profile. Bone dry and medium-light bodied, this wine has minerality for days, reflecting the cold climate, rocky soils laced with oyster shells, and nearby ocean mist.
collection: Cobble Hill Winery; Vancouver Island; White; Wine

name: Unsworth N/V Ovation Fortified "Port Style"
description:
Aged in a solera going back to 2009, Ovation is not too sweet while expressing bright red fruit flavours complemented by tawny notes of fig, chocolate, and coffee.

 

Marechal Foch.  Fortified to 19.2%

name: Odd Society Burns Bog Smoked Malt Whisky
description:
Burns Bog is the largest raised peat bog in North America and home
to hundreds of plant, animal, and bird species, many of which are
endangered. Bogs around the world are also said to be home to
mysterious monsters, lights, and creatures, which lurk about, waiting
to prey upon unsuspecting travellers.
Through the Burns Bog Conservation Society, we were able to obtain
a limited amount of Burns Bog peat, which was used to smoke some
of the malt that went into making this spirit. The whisky is smooth
and smoky with hints of cacao and chocolate on the nose, rich burnt
caramel on the palate, and a long warm finish that welcomes you to
the world of Burns Bog.

name: Odd Society Solera Barrel Gin
description: Solera Barrel Gin, is our Wallflower Gin aged in a 30-litre American white oak rye cask.  Gin was added to this Solera Barrel over time and now ranges from 3 to 4.5 years old.   Extra time spent in oak adds a rich, smooth texture, and elevates the woody spice notes. Strong citrus flavours are coupled with a surprising fruitiness, and plum notes are pleasingly integrated with vanilla.

name: Emandare 2022 'Traditional Method' Blanc De Blancs
description: Primarily Chardonnay with a splash of Gewurztraminer for aromatics and rested on the lees for 12 months before disgorging a limited 10 cases for Christmas before we officially release the rest of it in the Spring. This bubbly is a crowd pleaser for any and all festive occasions. Apple and zesty citrus meets delicate floral notes as the tiny creamy bubbles dance across your palate and hint at sweet fresh brioche.

name: Synchromesh 2023 Thorny Vines "Dry" Riesling
description: About a third of the way up the Naramata Bench with a Northern aspect, the Thorny Vines property is lovingly cared for by the Hornby-Smiths. Reaching into slightly richer loamy soils, these vines bring palate weight and a linear acidity not seen from our other properties.  Citrus and mandarin explode on the nose leading to a very textured mouthfeel of tropical fruit and apple. A sweet kiss lifts the fruit until the Thorny Vines acidity wipes it clean to a nearly dry finish.

name: 2022 Storm Haven Blue Label "Dry" Riesling
description: Synchromesh's only Riesling that sees time in barrel. It spent 12 months in a neutral French oak puncheon, on the lees, to develop further texture.

name: Salt Spring Wild Pineapple Guava  - 355 ml
description: A gently sweet cider made with culinary apples and fresh pineapple and guava juice. Unfiltered, so expect a little pulp and a lot of flavour. 6.2% ABV (4 pack of 355 ml cans)
collection: Gulf Islands; Cider;Salt Spring Wild Cider House

name: Odd Society Mushroom Whisky 375 ml
description:
PORCINI & CANDY CAP CANADIAN SINGLE MALT WHISKY

This whisky began as a community collaboration project with friends and neighbours. The innovation and success that it had meant it was important that we continue to produce this unique whisky. Porcini

and candy cap mushrooms are now in season, sourced by David Xiao of Oyster & King.

The nose gives you a mossy meadow, sweet earth, and savoury maple. The rich mouthfeel includes hints of browned butter, toasted almonds, burnt caramel, ending with a long, sweet, mushroom umami finish.

Enjoy neat, on ice or in a autumn Old Fashioned.

Order P&CC Canadian Single Malt Whisky direct delivery only Order desk: orderdesk@oddsocietyspirits.com

Orders can also be placed with your local reps.

Price: $33.45 SKU: 405611

Bottle size: 375 ml

Odd Society is a small-batch craft distillery in the heart of East Vancouver, dedicated to combining old-world distilling traditions with new-world ingredients and ingenuity to create a family of spirits that intrigue and entice.

name: Synchromesh Paddle Shift Riesling Spritzer 24 pack
description:
This wine contains a little bit of fruit from each property we farm for Riesling, brought together with a light soda spritz to make the ultimate mid-week companion… or anytime.

Very slightly off-dry with refreshing acidity bubbling across the finish.

250 ml cans
24 units per flat

name: Salt Spring Wild Wild Pear and Quince
description: Made with hand foraged Salt Spring Island wild seed pears, tannic cider pears, Asian pears, and quince. Cold fermented using native yeast, then bottle conditioned to carbonate. Gently sweet due to the natural residual sugar from the pears. It's a somewhat juicy cider that pours cloudy, very fragrant with notes of melon, white pepper, and Manuka honey."
collection: Gulf Islands; Cider;Salt Spring Wild Cider House

name: Salt Spring Wild Pineapple Guava - Keg
description: A tropical vacation in a glass. A gently sweet cider made with pesticide-free culinary apples, fresh pineapple and guava juice.
collection: Keg; Gulf Islands; Cider;Salt Spring Wild Cider House

name: Ones Sparkling Sauvignon Blanc 750 ml
description:
Appellation: Okanagan Valley, Canada

Grapes: Chardonnay

Calories: 18 calories/glass

name: Unsworth 2023 Allegro "Island White Blend" Keg
description: Aromas of ripe peach, green papaya, and soft floral notes on the nose, which leads to a bright mid palate and refreshing length. This unique and hyperlocal blend of Petit Milo and Sauvignette is a true Vancouver Island hallmark.
collection: Vancouver Island; White;Unsworth Vineyards; Keg; Wine

name: 1 Mill Road 2023 Chardonnay
description:
This wine is produced from one of Naramata’s oldest vineyards and is certified  sustainable. Planted in 1998, with unknown clones, these self-rooted vines grow and thrive in largely un-disturbed soils with no contouring or disruption.

The grapes were hand-picked and whole bunch pressed almost immediately after picking. The juice was then transferred directly to French oak puncheons and barriques (34% new) and barrelled on full solids. At the completion of primary fermentation, sulphur was added to ensure that malolactic fermentation did not
occur. The barrels were stirred every 3-4 weeks with minimal ullage on the ferment lees. The wine aged in barrel for nine months before blending, gentle filtering, and bottling.

name: 1 Mill Road 2023 Pinot Noir Rosé
description: This Pinot Noir Rosé is make from grapes grown on the East Kelowna Slopes, on of BC's newest Sub-GI's.Vibrant pale salmon in appearance, expressing a delicate and floral nose with aromas of rose petals, orange peel, white pepper, and sea spray.The palate is refreshing with savoury notes and an acid line that balances this wine's subtle fruit sweetness.  A chalky undertone creates a rounding cadence on the palate.  The finish is intriguing, refined and bone dry with great persistance.

name: 1 Mill Road 2022 Home Block Pinot Noir
description: Grown on the Okanagan Valley’s heavier silty soils of the Naramata Bench, this vineyard site maximizes southwest exposure and the close proximity to Okanagan Lake allows for long days and a long growing season. Handpicked and hand sorted, the grapes are fermented and aged in beautiful wooden French oak tanks in the Naramata Wine Vault.

name: 1 Mill Road 2022 Black Pine Pinot Noir
description: Produced from Black Pine Vineyard, a 4-acre slice of paradise on the Naramata Bench. The Pinot Noir portion of the vineyard is planted to clones 667, 777, 115 and Pommard.A bright ruby colour that is lifted and fragrant on the nose, with a ripe sense of red fruits – dusty cherries, fresh cranberries and overripe strawberries. Swirling brings changes of complexity, with brown cardamom-like spices, crushed gravel and a light herbal edge from the whole bunch fermentation. The palate exudes the above fruit flavours, with a noticeable, youthful density, all wrapped in dusty, fine, savoury tannins with brightness in acidity that drives line and length.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 Pinot Blanc "Lawson"
description:
No skin contact at all, so pure and fresh, just the most aromatic expression of Pinot Blanc.
Asian pear, ripe apple skin, citrus candy on the nose.  This wine is well structured, balanced and juicy with medium texture on the mid palate and long delicate finish.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 Piquette Blanc
description:
No sulfur added this is a little funkier than the past three vintages, if you like low intervention wines, this is for you. 
It’s only 6% alcohol, almost like a sour beer; maybe try it as a breakfast or brunch wine. 
There’s a little spritz on it, with some honeyed slightly reductive notes. Orange popsicle. Earthy funkiness. Yeasty - leesy.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2023 Chardonnay Barrel Ferment
description:
100% Chardonnay grown on the estate vineyard in Kaledan, BC.

 

Whole cluster pressed with a gentle press cycle to ensure the highest quality of juice. Left to rest on light lees for 9 months before being bottled unfined and unfiltered.

 

Tropical notes of pineapple, white peach and citrus on the nose with hints of
toasted bread , butter and apple. The palate is full and textured with bright
juicy acidity. A beautiful classic wine.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2019 Wild Ferment Brut Méthod Ancestrale
Anthony Buchanan 2022 Viognier
description:
Perfumed aromas of peach, mango and orange blossom.  A textured, bright mid palate of preserved lemon reduction with flecks of herbal notes make this a classic cool climate Viognier.
Sustainably farmed from Mahli Farms, Oliver

name: Anthony Buchanan 2023 Trois Orange
description:
Vineyard

Origin: Estate Vineyard Kaleden, St.Hubertus Vineyard Kelowna

Varietal: 84% Gewurztraminer, 12% Pinot Gris, 4% Pinot Blanc

 

Cellar

Crush pad: Destem whole berry to open top tanks, a small portion of Gew

Was fermented whole cluster (semi-carbonic).

Fermentation: Wild yeast, 4 weeks on skins, foot tread twice per day

Malolactic: Yes, natural bacteria

Aging: 9 months in 59% Amphora, 22% Neutral Oak, 19% Concrete

 

Lively notes of tea leaf, mango, guava and ripe kiwi fruit from start to finish. The core of the wine has depth with intense fruit, character and a bit of grip from the whole cluster portion. The finish is bright, long and juicy.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2021 Grape Apple Dandelion
description:
Made from Braeburn and Pink Lady apples, spending 2 weeks macerating before being mashed, pressed, and fermented in neutral oak. Blended with hand-harvested chardonnay and a touch of organic dandelion rounds out what is sure to be the most unique but delightful wine of the summer!
Fresh, textured, with a lovely honeyed apricot note from the skin-ferment Viognier, I love how hand crafted this wine feels. The Chardonnay musqué brings beautiful aromatics.
12% ABV

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 SNAFU
description: 48% Gewurztraminer, 24% Pinot Blanc, 16% Sauvignon Blanc, 12% Chardonnay Musqué.Aging: 9 months in 60% Neutral Oak, 24% Amphora, 16% New French OakDistinctive aromas of spice/ginger, stone fruit and honey. Floral, peach skin and apple with mineral undertones lead through the palate creating texture and freshness.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 Ramato Gris
description: In Northeast Italy they make a style of wine from their Pinot Grigio grapes called ‘Ramato’; the grapes are crushed, then spend time on the skins to gain texture and a gorgeous copper colour.Pinot Gris left on its skins for 72 hours and then fermented in Amphora. The Gew was in 100% concrete. No neutral oak this year at all, so that mineral-y, slate characteristic is more evident. It’s a little lighter in colour but still has those beautiful rose petals on the nose.Rose and lavender, with hints of citrus and orange peel dominate the nose leading to fennel and jasmine with flecks of melon rind on the palate. The wine is lively and finishes with fresh crisp acidity.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2021 Riesling Amphora
description:
Brand-new amphora and skin fermented for nine days. I really like mineral-driven wines, especially Riesling; for me it’s their stand-out trait. The amphora keeps that purity of fruit and brings an earthy component to this wonderfully textural wine that I think will age well. Expect lemon rind, grapefruit, notes of gun flint and jasmine.
12% ABV

name: Anthony Buchanan 2021 Viognier Micro Cuvée
description:
100% Viognier, single vineyard, from Malhi Farm in Oliver, BC. Direct pressed, wild barrel ferment. 12 months on lees.
Grilled pineapple, orange peel & toast, fleshy & textured with a juicy bite of acid that will coat the palate.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 Petillant Naturel Muscat
description: On the crush pad, grapes were foot stomped prior to pressing. Spontaneous fermentation in stainless steel.  Aged 4 months in bottle.Honeysuckle, Asian pear and a cantaloupe melon note up front. Balanced acidity and a creamy textured mid-palate compliment the persistent bubbles.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 Semillon
description:
The Semillon came in first and sat on the skins for 72 hours, lightly foot trod and then pressed to neutral barrels with some lees stirring through malolactic fermentation. The Sauvignon Blanc had a two week skin ferment and fermented in stainless steel.  
Classic Semillon with notes of guava, lemon, and beeswax. Aromatic and creamy and the Sauvignon Blanc brings  passionfruit and hay on the nose.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2023 Pinot Gris
description: 100% Pinot Gris from Anthony Buchanan's organic vineyard.  Whole cluster, spontaneous fermentation in 57% Barrel and 43% Stainless steel. Ripe aromas of nectarine, mango, pear and citrus. The palate is fresh, honeyed and full of energy with a long intense finish.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2020 Malbec Rosé Keg
description:
The Malbec for this deeper hued rosé comes from Gurjeet Vineyard, Osoyoos, from 12 year old vines on gravel, sandy loams.
Partial carbonic, partial direct press, with a native ferment in neutral barrel and stainless, with 4.5 months on lees prior to bottling without filtration.
Juicy candied strawberries, raspberries, cherry gummies flood the medium bodied palate, seasoned with fine spicing and finishing with a tart blackcurrant note, balanced off with a slight bump of RS.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 FUBAR
description:
39% Pinot Noir, 36% Gamay, 15% Syrah, 6% Merlot, 4% Pinot Blanc
Aging: 9 months in Barrel, 65% Neutral, 15% third fill, 10% Amphora, 10% New French
A fruit explosion on the nose of ripe cherry, raspberry and plum lead to slightly darker fruit on the palate. There’s a cool candy cane (menthol/mint) element to the wine which is compelling. Silky, fresh and pure!

name: Anthony Buchanan 2023 Pinot Noir Ashlyn
description:
Organically farmed at Horak Vineyard in Cawston, BC.   

Destemmed, no crushing in open top tanks.  Spontaneous fermentation. 

Aged 10 months in 10% New French, 15% Concrete and 75% Neutral Oak

No Fining or Filtration

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 Syrah William Dean
description: From the Testalinden Vineyard in Oliver, BC. 50% whole cluster and 50% Destemmed. Fermented in open tanks. Aged 12 months in Hungarian, French & Neutral Oak. Wild blueberries, plums and fresh cracked peppercorns. Notes of violets and earth. Limited supply.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 Gamay Noir
description:
100% Gamay Noir 
Two tanks were done as semi-carbonic ferments, everything else de-stemmed, no crushing.  Seven days on the skins then pressed off to tank.  Racked to 95% neutral, 5% French oak.
Lush, bright and red fruit driven. Candied red berries, dark cherry and pomegranate coat the mouth while the natural acidity will quench the palate.
Best served chilled.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2021 Zweigelt
description:
Co-fermented with 14% Viognier. Foot trod, twice-daily for a week on the skins, settled for 48 hours, then 6.5 months in a 500L puncheon. Direct bottled from the barrel.
Big aromatic punch of black fruits, wild herbs, licorice and cherry blossom. Bright, tart and fresh with fine silky tannins compliment the long finish.
12% ABV

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 Petit Verdot Ancestrale
description:
100% Petit Verdot de-stemmed, whole berry, 11 day maceration, pressed off to stainless.
Fizzy aromas of raspberry, plum skin and black cherry seduction evoke clean savoury notes of stone fruit and rose/violet accents.

name: Anthony Buchanan 2022 FOMO
description:
60% Gamay, 30% Syrah, 6% Pinot Noir, 4% Sauvignon Blanc
Aging: 9 months in 47% Second fill French Oak, 42% Second fill Hungarian Oak, 7% Fourth fill French Oak, 4% Stainless barrels
Silky red and black fruits reminiscent of red and black cherries, black pepper and earth. Light and refreshing with juicy acidity.

name: Cannon Estate Pondéré White 2022
description: Pondéré was produced by using techniques traditionally practiced in the Alsace region of France. It is comprised of a blend of four varietals, primarily Muscat and Petite Milo. This wine was created with a balance of freshness and volume in mind.75% of grapes came from our herbicide-free vineyard. The other 25% were sourced from different vineyards in Oliver and KelownaAgeing - In order to increase the complexity and the volume of the wine, we aged part of the wine in barrel for six months (70% new oak, medium toast) and one month in bottle.Simplified Tasting Notes - Candied Orange, Apricot, Green Pineapple, Grapefruit  It contains nuanced aromas of candied orange, white flower, apricot and pear. The palate is dry with nice volume and notes of apricot and pineapple. The finish is fresh with notes of minerality and ruby grapefruit.Varietals - Complex blend of four varietals, primarily Muscat and Petite Milo12.5% alc./vol.
collection: White;Cannon Estate Winery; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Allégresse 2021
description: Allégresse was produced by using techniques practiced in the Burgundy region of France. Containing mostly Chardonnay, this wine has pronounced aromas of white flower, apple and acacia honey. The palate is met with beautiful volume, toast and grapefruit. The long finish of minerality is complimented by lemon and vanilla.This year, because of the young age of our vineyard, only 50% came from our vineyard (no herbicide and only organic spray products). The other part came from different vineyards in Oliver and Kelowna.Ageing - This year, because of the vintage, Allégresse was aged for 10 months in barrel (30% new French oak) and for 2 months in bottle before release.Simplified Tasting Notes - White Flower, Green Apple, Acacia Honey, GrapefruitVarietals - A complex blend mainly consisting of Chardonnay.12.5% alc./vol.
collection: White;Cannon Estate Winery; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate The Wick Buckle Up White Cans 250 ml
description: The Wick "Buckle Up" White is a blend of Pinot Gris and Gewürztraminer 11.5% ABV
collection: White;Cannon Estate Winery; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Rêverie Rose 2022
description: Rêverie was produced by using techniques traditionally practiced in the Provence region of France. Comprised mainly of Syrah and Merlot, this wine is elegant, aromatic, well balanced and refreshing. A powerful, yet balanced nose of wild strawberry, orange blossom and citrus continue through to the dry palate with added notes of apple and more strawberry. A medium bodied rosé with a long and fresh finish.Due to the young age of our vineyard, these grapes were sourced from Oliver, Osoyoos and Kelowna.Ageing - This year, we aged part of the wine in barrel for three months (30% old barrel) and one month in bottle.Simplified Tasting Notes - Orange Blossom, Green Apple, Wild Strawberry, LemonVarietals - Complex blend of four varietals, mainly Syrah12% alc./vol.
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Rosé; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate The Wick Buckle Up Rosé Cans 250 ml
description: The Wick "Buckle Up" Rosé Wine is a blend of Gamay Noir and Pinot Noir11.5% ABV
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Rosé; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Wick Highflier Rosé 2022
description: Highflier was created by combining New World and Old World wine making techniques. This wine is a pure expression of our Winemaker's creativity, resulting in an exceptionally aromatic, clear rosé with distinct freshness. With aromas of ripe muscat, honeysuckle and apple on the nose that continue through to the palate with added notes of candy, marshmallow and raspberry. The finish is crisp and citrusy.Due to the young age of our vineyard, these grapes were sourced from Kelowna and Osoyoos.Ageing - This wine was aged in tank to maintain freshness and the delicate aromatic fruitiness and colour of the wine.Simplified Tasting Notes - Honeysuckle, Raspberry, Toasted MarshmallowVarietals - The main variatel, a Winemaker's secret, with a hint of Syrah and Merlot12% alc./vol.
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Rosé; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Rapture Rose 2022
description: Rapture was produced by using techniques traditionally practiced in the Bordeaux region of France. Containing mostly Merlot and Cabernet Franc, this concentrated dark rosé has pronounced aromas of white pepper and cassis. Dry and savoury, the palate is met with a hint of tannins, nice volume and notes of blackberry and raspberry. The cassis and vanilla finish is long and refreshing.This year, we used 45% of grapes that came from our herbicide-free vineyard, and 55% from different vineyards in Oliver and Kelowna.Ageing - This year, we aged part of the wine in barrel for six months (30% old oak) and one month in bottle.Simplified Tasting Notes - Blackberry, White Pepper, Cassis, VanillaVarietals - Complex blend of four varietals, mostly Merlot and Cabernet Franc12% alc./vol.
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Rosé; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Sedulous Red 2021
description: Sedulous was produced using techniques traditionally practiced in the Côte-Rôtie region of France. It is 90% Syrah and 10% Viognier. A complex wine with pronounced aromas, robust volume, and smooth concentrated flavour. Notes of violet and leather on the nose followed by cherry, cocoa and coffee. The palate is dry and balanced with spice, cherry and meatiness.The Syrah came from Oliver and the Viognier from Osoyoos and Keremeos.This year, because of the hot weather, we aged the wine for 10 months (30% new French oak) and in bottle for one month before release.Simplified Tasting Notes - Violet, Black Cherry, Cocoa, SpiceSyrah and Viognier13.5% alc./vol.
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Fervour Red 2021
description:
Bordeaux-style Cabernet Franc blend

 

Notes of Lilac, Spice, Dark Fruit, Coffee
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Wick Whizz Kid Red
description: Whizz Kid was created by combining New World and Old World wine making techniques with a main focus on fruit. Blackberry, plum and cherry liqueur on the nose with a body of medium tannins and volume. Lightly concentrated and structured, the palate is dry with notes of green pepper and cassis on the finish.Most of the grapes come from a rocky and well-exposed vineyard in Oliver, and the rest from Kelowna.We aged this wine in tank, not barrel, in order to respect the aromatic fruitiness and freshness of the wine.
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Wick Doer 2021
description: Doer was created by combining New World and Old World winemaking techniques with a main focus on fruit. This wine has aromas of cherry, spice and violet followed by black fruit and vanilla. A medium bodied, dry red with a palate of plum, black pepper and red cherry. It is concentrated but still has a nice freshness to avoid feeling overly heavy.Most the grapes come from Oliver from a rocky and well exposed vineyard, with a small percentage coming from Kelowna.Ageing - This year we aged part of the wine in barrel for 10 months and one month in bottle before release.Simplified Tasting Notes - Plum, Black Fruit, Spice, Red CherryVarietals -Mainly Cabernet Franc and Merlot14% alc./vol.
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Wick Bootstrapper 2021
description: Bootstrapper was created using mostly New World style winemaking techniques. It is a blend of Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Petit Verdot. On the nose you get aromas of dark fruit, spice, violet and vanilla. On the palate there is cherry and black pepper with a long spicy finish.Most the grape varietals come from Oliver from a rocky and well exposed vineyard and a small percentage came from Osoyoos.Ageing - This year we aged the wine for 12 months in barrel and one month in bottle before release.Simplified Tasting Notes - Black Pepper, Cherry, Sweet Tobacco and Vanilla BeanVarietals - A blend of Cabernet Franc, Merlot and Petit Verdot14% alc./vol.
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Fleur Bleue 2022
description:
Burgundy-style Gamay and Pinot Blend

 

Notes of Cherry Blossom, Bing Cherry with a hint of vanilla
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Cannon Estate Ardour Red 2021
description: Ardour was produced using techniques traditionally used in Bordeaux and the Southwest region of Cahors. Dry, concentrated and full bodied but still fresh and well balanced. On the nose there are aromas of violet, spice and leather followed by dark cherry, blackberry and coffee. On the palate you will find blackberry, cocoa, spice and black currant.Most of the grape varietals came from vineyards in Oliver and the rest from Keremeos.Ageing - This year we aged the wine for 14 months in barrel and two months in bottle before release.Simplified Tasting Notes- Violet, Dark Cherry, Cocoa, BlackcurrantVarietals - A blend of Malbec, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc and Merlot.13.5% alc./vol.
collection: Cannon Estate Winery; Red; Wine; Lower Mainland

name: Emandare 2024 Gewürztraminer
description:
A step away from sweet and into textured and sophisticated. Neutral barrel fermented and left on the lees for 4 months, this dry wine drinks beautifully balanced with so much silky texture.

 

Ripe pear, soft white rose pedal, baked apple and complex mineral notes fill your whole palate with satisfaction.
collection: Emandare Vineyard; White; Vancouver Island; Wine

name: Emandare 2024 Sauvignon Blanc
description: From the oldest planting of Sauvignon Blanc vines on Vancouver Island here at Emandare, we adore this wine. Something magic happens in the way it ripens and uniquely expresses itself on our vineyard. Vibrant white wild flowers, spiced pears, kiwi, melon, complex minerality and layer upon layer of bright aromas and flavours only begin to describe this wine. Barrel fermented and left on the lees, giving it a soft and lovely texture.

name: Emandare 2022 FTV Chardonnay
description: An exciting new wine for us in 2023.  Very expressive, bright and refreshing.  Driven by a citrus backbone that is highlighted with lovely apple and melon texture, framed by aromatics of white peach and highlighted with precise minerality.A lean chardonnay that is intricate and delicate.

name: Emandare 2024 PS
description:
60% Pinot Noir | 30% Siegerrebe | 10% Chardonnay

 

PS we also made this limited edition aromatic blend of Pinot Noir, Siegerrebe and Chardonnay. This is your ideal sipper in the sunshine. Soft stone fruit flavours and floral aromas leap out of your glass followed by zesty refreshing flavours of melon and citrus.

name: Emandare 2023 Estate Rosé
description: A unique field blend that we have been fine tuning annually. 65% Siegerrebe, 13% Foch, 12% Tempranillo, and 10% Dornfelder. This Rosé is bright and vibrant on your palate with ridiculously juicy notes of citrus, apple, pear, melon and wild cherry.

name: Emandare 2021 Alice
description:
Traditional Method Rosé made from 100% Cowichan Pinot Noir. 
A very special, limited release wine named after our second born daughter, Alice. The simple description on the back of the bottle is; "Full of Life." This only begins to describe the wonderful nature of our lovely little girl. An effervescent light pink sparkling wine that is like sipping sophisticated pink lemonade with subtle strawberries, peach and citrus tones.

name: Emandare 2022 FTV Blanc De Noir
description: 100% Pinot Noir with just a touch of skin contact giving it a very slight coloured hue.Floral and citrus notes meet with apple and pear brought together with mouth-watering savoury tones and textures.

name: Emandare 2022 FTV Farm Fresh Foch
description:
Made from 85% Marechal Foch and 15% Pinot Noir, this fresh, Nouveau (French for "New") style of wine is a very youthful and juicy style of red wine. 
100% Whole Cluster Carbonic Maceration, this wine is singing with vibrant notes of bright red cherry, fresh wild flowers and juicy plums. How Mike describes this wine: "Juicy and Chuggable!"

name: Emandare 2023 Estate Pinot Noir
description: From 25 year old vines, our Pinot Noir is gently stewarded from grapes into wine with minimal intervention. Both fermented and aged in neutral French oak and left unfined and unfiltered, to capture the truly authentic expression of Emandare’s nature. Soft black cherry and prune plum, violets, wild mushroom, subtle apple and clean minerality and a depth of texture so unique to our Pinot Noir. This only begins to describe this terroir driven wine.

name: Emandare 2023 Estate Maréchal Foch
description: From 25 year old vines, our signature Marechal Foch is gently stewarded from grapes into wine with minimal intervention. Both fermented and aged in neutral French oak and left unfined and unfiltered, to capture a bold expression of Emandare’s nature. Enjoy robust flavours of blackcurrant, black cherry, blueberry, subtle blackberry and dark plum with cracked pepper and subtle savoury mouth watering tones.

name: Emandare 2021 FTV Pinot Noir
description: Bright and very juicy. 50% destemmed, 50% whole cluster and fermented in neutral open top puncheons. Gently stewarded from grapes into wine with minimal intervention. A light coloured pinot that packs a fruit punch. Raspberries, strawberries, red cherries and red currents meet apples and rose pedals. This is a very exciting expression of true to form Island Pinot Noir.

name: Emandare 2022 Syrah
description: We had a unique opportunity to work with some exceptional quality organically farmed Okanagan Syrah in 2022. Silky smooth, soft and round on your palate. Our favourite Syrah’s come from cool vintages in warm climate regions, 2022 in Oliver was the perfect example. A very pretty wine, violets and lilacs leap out of your glass carried by subtle black cherry and apple, complemented by a savoury black pepper and a sea salted texture.

name: Emandare 2022 FTV Valley Red
description:
A unique blend of two very familiar grapes to the Cowichan Valley. 70% Pinot Noir and 30% Maréchal Foch, whole cluster fermented separately and blended together in neutral french oak barrels to rest for 12 month.
Very juicy, soft and round on your palate. An everyday red wine. Bright and refreshing wild red cherry, garden raspberry and orchard apple with a mouth watering texture that is meant for more than just sipping.

name: Lock & Worth 2022 Sauvignon Blanc + Sémillon
description: 74% Sauvignon Blanc + 26% Sémillon. Planted in Naramata. Focused, lithe and dry. A very crunchy/herbal vintage. Citrus pith, lemon verbena, hay. Dry and fresh. Unfined and unfiltered. Now-2024.

name: Lock & Worth 2021 Sémillon "Knorr Vineyard" Kelowna
description: 100% Semillon. Ever so slightly cloudy/matte sunny hay in colour. This is very lithe and focused and low in alc (10.4%) Ripe citrus rind, sage and hay. Sneaky bright and intense palate of apple skin and green tea but dry and driven.

name: Lock & Worth 2020 Sémillon Losthorn Vineyard
description: This is the third vintage we have made Semillon from this vineyard planted in Okanagan Falls in 1995. This is a warmer site than our Kelowna vineyard and is picked earlier for acid retention. Destemmed and direct pressed this is fermented in a combination of stainless steel and old barriques. It spent only 6 months in barrel and is a brighter and fresher interpretation of Semillon. 2020 is more opulent and we think it will benefit from at least another 6 months or a year in bottle. Unfined and unfiltered but clear and with little to no sediment. Sunny/hay yellow. Clear and youthful. Cereal, wool and honeycomb on the nose. Medium bodied, clover and anise all wrapped around citrus curd and melon. Fresh acidity and a persistent crunchy finish make this intense and moreish. Dry. Can easily handle a little spice or medium weight proteins. Drink now - 2025

name: Lock & Worth 2022 Cabernet Franc Rose White Label
description: Off Dry. Big and bright aromatics of cherry pop rocks, candy apple and sweet thyme. Medium bodied and off dry with a big mouthfeel and ripe red tree fruits. There is good acidity here to buoy the sweetness and it never comes across as cloying. This is sneaky dangerous rose and we are loving it with sushi, spicy BBQ chicken, and watermelon/summer salads. From the original Poplar Grove Vineyard planted in 1995. 3 hours of skin contact in the press. Stainless steel ferment and old oak barrel ageing. The fermentation stopped on us in January leaving some residual sugar so we had to filter this wine. Bright, candy apricot in colour.

name: Lock & Worth 2022 Cabernet Franc Rose Grey Label
Lock & Worth 2022 Merlot Rosé "Apricot Hill"
description:
Whole cluster pressed with 1.5 hours of skin contact. Fermentation in stainless steel and elevage in old oak. Unfined and Unfiltered. 

Dark, rich and savoury red berry fruit. Intense plum and herbs with fresh acidity and a long dry and moreish finish

This is from 1 acre on Matt's property planted in 2004 and currently undergoing organic conversion. The vineyard has a huge wild apricot tree on the west hill.

name: Lock & Worth 2023 Merlot "Naramata"
description: 2 acres planted in 1995. Sand. Naramata Bench. Gently de-stemmed – 5 days of skin contact. Basket pressed. Fermented in neutral French oak for 7 months. Unfined and unfiltered.

name: Marichel 2023 Marichel Estate Viognier
description:
Hand harvested over our estate vineyards and eight micro climates. The fruit is whole cluster pressed, cold settled and then moved to 100 percent tight grained French oak barrels.
This delicious and complex barrel aged Viognier has subtle floral aromas of creamy golden apple and honeydew melon, with complimentary scents of crème brûlée, along with a minerally overtone.  A full bodied palate offering intense and expansive melon, peaches and pear flavours accentuated by fresh, perfectly balanced acidity.

name: Marichel 2022 Marichel Syrah Rosé
description: Our Rosé is 100% Syrah that is Estate-grown on the Naramata Bench. Whole cluster pressed to minimize colour extraction.  A dry, crisp & fruity lean style that offers aromatics of tart cherry, strawberry and light citrus, sage and earth.

name: Marichel 2020 Marichel Estate Syrah
description: 100% Syrah from harvested from Block 4 which has a perfect southwest orientation.  Fermented in individual vats with daily punchdowns.  36 months in 100% new, premium oak with medium toast.

name: Marichel 2023 Marichel Lone Wolf Syrah
description:
Introducing an old favourite with a new name. Sourced entirely from the Marichel Estate Vineyard, the Lone Wolf is our popular Syrah-Viognier blend with a classic, Rhone Valley identity. 
Fermented in wide stainless steel tank to increase skin contact.Viognier co-fermented with the Syrah. Malolactic fermentation started in tank and completed in barrel.  36 months aged premium oak, medium toast, 60% new.
Our style is a bit spicier with freshness. Classic violet and pepper notes leading into ripe fruits of blackberry and raspberry. Crushed stones and hints of wild sage. On the palate, a generous mid palate mouth-feel with some grip and weight.

name: Nagging Doubt 2022 Bright Idea Sparkling
description: Made entirely from our Sallows Road Vineyard, estate grown Chardonnay and Pinot Noir. This wine has lovely effervesce, with balanced acidity.  A dry, crisp wine, it’s aromas hint of sweet, bright cherries, strawberries and cotton candy with citrus undertones.

name: Nagging Doubt 2022 Siegerrebe
description: Estate grown at our Sallows Road vineyard in the Okanagan Valley's East Kelowna Slopes sub-GI.These grapes were harvested from our estate vineyard at 20⁰ Brix on October 7, 2022 to preserve the acidity of this notoriously low-acid varietal. On the nose and palate, this wine is intensely aromatic – an extremely complex profile of flowers, lychee, tangerine, spice, and citrus can be detected

name: Nagging Doubt 2021 Chardonnay "Sallows Road"
description:
Estate-grown in South East Kelowna, made from two French Chardonnay clones (76 and 95).
Production Notes:
Fermented slowly at 15⁰C to preserve the grape’s natural aromatics, this wine was aged in 30% new French oak puncheons, and 70% in stainless steel for 8 months.

name: Nagging Doubt 2022 A Little Doubtful Rosé Trio - 200 ml
description: Vibrant and refreshing, this is perfection in pink! While this is a dry, crisp wine, it hints at red berries and bright cherries, with floral and citrus undertones. Effervescent, with balanced acidity.This 200 mL pocket-sized bottle comes in a 3-pack

name: Nagging Doubt 2022 Pinot Noir
description: From young vines grown at the south-facing Hartman Road vineyard, the 2022 Pinot Noir boasts the deep colour and intensity unique to our East Kelowna terroir. An ideal "gateway red", this big Pinot hints at fruitiness–cherry, raspberry, and pomegranate–with a subtle baking spice undertone and vanilla nose. Aged for 12 months in 30% new French oak,

name: Nagging Doubt 2022 Malbec
description:
Harvested October 30, 2022, from the Red Brick Vineyard in Osoyoos, in the Okanagan Valley.  Aged 20 months in 40% new American and French.

 

Our fourth release as a single varietal, this wine continues to be a beautiful example of Canadian cold-climate Malbec. Notes of ripe cassis, blackberry, cherry, and pepper prevail, with a subtle vanilla influence from new oak. Medium-bodied, with soft tannins, balanced acidity, and succulent juiciness

name: Nagging Doubt 2021 The Pull
description:
The Pull is, a rich red blend consisting primarily of Merlot (60%), supported by Cabernet Sauvignon (21%), Malbec (16%), and a touch of Cabernet Franc (3%).

 

Fruit for The Pull is sourced from two Okanagan Valley regions: Oliver for the Merlot, and Osoyoos for the remaining components.  Aged for 20 months in 43% new French and American oak.

name: Nagging Doubt 2021 The Leap
description:
Sourced from Okanagan Valley vineyards in Oliver (Merlot) and Osoyoos.

Production Notes
Aged for 20 months in 48% new French and American oak.

 

Traditional red blend, this Merlot-dominant wine (72%) also contains Malbec (20%) and splashes of Cabernet Sauvignon (5%), and Cabernet Franc (3%).

name: Nagging Doubt 2022 Merlot
description:
Harvested October 18, 2022, from Mythology Vineyard in Oliver, in the Okanagan Valley.   Aged for 20 months in 40% new French oak.

 

Plum, blackberry, cherry, and mocha notes are plentiful on the nose and palate, supported by balanced oak and a nice acidity. Pairs beautifully with any grilled meat, especially pork.

name: Nichol Vineyard 2021 Pinot Gris
description:
Handpicked, given up to 36 hours of skin contact and fermented in a combination of stainless steel and neutral French oak.  Gorgeous blush colour.
Aromas of fuzzy peaches, apricot skin, and grapefruit . Medium bodied with citrus pith and apricot pits and lemon curd on the dry but rich palate. Very versatile food companion - from soft cheese to roast chicken and salmon.
Planted from 1990-2005 on a mix of granite, granite shard, loess and glacial till. 100% Naramata village.

name: Nichol Vineyard 2022 Pinot Gris
description:
Clear and youthful with a very slight straw hue. This vintage retained very little colour despite 36 hours of skin contact prior to ferment.
Aromas of fuzzy peaches, apricot skin, and grapefruit . Medium bodied with citrus pith and apricot pits and lemon curd on the dry but rich palate. Very versatile food companion - from soft cheese to roast chicken and salmon.
Planted from 1990-2005 on a mix of granite, granite shard, loess and glacial till. 
100% Naramata village.

name: Nichol Vineyard "Two Barrels" Pinot Gris
description: Two Barrels Pinot Gris has more intense aromatics and a richer, rounder and softer palate as this goes through 100% malolactic fermentation. Unfined and Unfiltered

name: Nichol Vineyard 2022 Extra Brut
description:
Pale grapefruit pink in colour. Earthy strawberries and cream, a hint of brioche and red apple skin on the clean and bright nose. A light to medium bodied bubble, very dry but softer and creamier than previous vintages with ripe apple skin, honey comb and toast. Unfined and Unfiltered.
Planted in 2000 up and behind Nichol this Pinot Noir vineyard is wonderful for the production of traditional sparkling wine. In addition, we finally have something to do with our Pinot Meunier (planted in 1989) which usually gets eaten by the birds every year as it is the thing to ripen before we can get our nets out.

name: Nichol Vineyard 2020 Syrah Nate’s Vineyard
description:
Vibrant ruby in colour. High toned aromatics of lilacs and fennel fronds with a touch of white pepper. Medium bodied and focused palate of ripe red berry fruits, sweet herbs and pepper. This is a fine, detailed version of our young vines that is easy to drink but has intense, crunchy persistence on the palate. Easy to drink now but we see this rewarding at 5 to 8 years in the cellar. Drink now to 2030.
Planted in 2007 on granite bedrock and glacial till in the southern quadrant of the property. 100% Naramata Village.

name: Nichol Vineyard 2022 Syrah "Old Vines"
description:
94 Points Decanter Magazine

The 2022 was coolish but very long, giving us red wines that are quite generous and supple while retaining solid acidities and fruit definition. We bottled this a few months later than usual and we think the extra spring months in barrel have helped to make this very approachable already.

Dark/purply/ruby and very vibrant showing tar and dark berry fruit along with lilacs and fennel. The palate is softer and more fruit driven than the 2019 (more like 2014) with sweet game, soil and black cherry. Ripe but present tannins and trademark refreshing acidity carry the long finish. While very easy to enjoy now this really has the stuffing to be one to watch over the next decade. Please decant.

Drink 2024 – 2032?+

name: Nichol Vineyard 2022 Village Cabernet Franc
description: Dark ruby. Youthful, vibrant. Garrigue, dark red fruits, soil and dill on the nose. Crunchy, packed palate of sage, iron and savoury berries. This is ripe Cabernet Franc that never forgets it is still varietal Cabernet Franc. Vineyard: 13 rows planted in 1989 on granite bedrock. 100% Naramata Village.Wine Making: Hand-picked late October 2020. De-stemmed in to open top fermenters. Basket pressed with malolactic taking place in neutral French barrique. Raised in neutral (3-6 years old) French oak barrels for 12 months. Racked twice and bottled unfined and unfiltered in March 2022.Drink Now - 2028+

name: Nichol Vineyard 2022 Pinot Noir 550M
description:
Nichol Pinot Noir 550M Elevation 

 

Lifted, savoury aromatics of thyme, nunderbrush, liquorish and red berries. Medium bodied, savoury fruit core. Medium tannins and fresh acidity drive the moreish finish. Vineyard:  4 acres, planted in 2000.  Alluvial till, clay Massal selection from Clone 115 and Spatburgunder Double Cane VSP 2.5 Tonnes per acre 550M Elevation Nichol 2020 Pinot Noir 550 90% Destemmed and 10% Whole Cluster

name: Nichol Vineyard 2022 Pinot Noir Whole Cluster - 280M
description: Nichol Vineyards has 6 rows of Clone 115 Pinot Noir originally planted in 1990 on the Estate next to the Winery.This wine is fermented with stems included, hence "Whole Cluster".  Medium matte ruby in colour. Savoury, spicy aromatics of thyme, pine forest, strawberry and earth. This is medium bodied but quite firm in the mouth with the ability to handle more substantial foods and proteins.

name: Nichol Vineyard 2022 Syrah "The Village"
description:
Vibrant ruby in colour. High toned aromatics of lilacs and fennel fronds with a touch of white pepper. Medium bodied and focused palate of ripe red berry fruits, sweet herbs and pepper. This is a fine, detailed version of our young vines that is easy to drink but has intense, crunchy persistence on the palate. Easy to drink now but we see this rewarding at 5 to 8 years in the cellar. Drink now to 2030.

Planted in 2007 on granite bedrock and glacial till in the southern quadrant of the property.

100% Naramata Village.

name: Odd Society Commodore Port Barrel Finished Single Malt Whisky 375 ml
description:
We took our three year old Commodore single malt whisky that had been aging in smaller ex-bourbon barrels and transferred it to a large, freshly emptied French oak port barrel and aged it for another fourteen months. The ex-port barrel adds beautiful deep colours, rich texture, and hints of dried fruit. A beautiful dram you won't want to miss.
375 ml  - 46% ABV

name: Odd Society Scottish Peat & Smoke Whisky 375 ml
description:
Canadian Single Malt Whisky, a softly smoked expression of peated whisky that is phenolic and viscous with classic Islay characteristics.
Notes of caramelized honey, supple leather and chestnuts on an open fire. Mouthfeel is full and creamy with flavours of charred oak and dried cocoa nibs.

name: Odd Society Commodore Single Malt Whisky 750 ml
description:
100% BC Single Malt barley aged in ex-Bourbon barrels for a least 4 years.  Commodore is a Scotch-style whisky but with the characteristics of local terroir.  When it was first released it was single-cask, with hand-written labels.  The line-ups on release day meant we could never make enough.  Today we store-away plenty to provide whisky lovers, with single malt all year round.
Nose: Beeswax, brown sugar, toasted croissant, cocao, malt, oak, vanilla, light heather.
Palate: Caramel, cocoa, oak, vanilla, tobacco, almond, hazelnut, creamy.
750 ml 46% ABV

name: Odd Society Mongrel Unaged Rye Spirit 750 ml
description:
Made from 100% BC Rye and bottled at 50% ABV, this is a refined moonshine, white dog, or white lightning. It goes straight from the still to the bottle. The strength of this spirit is not for the faint-hearted, but it has developed a following for its buttery candied notes while still being fairly neutral. It is often used as a white rum substitute, or to make infusions. Use in a Beach Rover, our version of a Pina Colada, or simply with tonic, ice and lemon.
Nose: Buttermilk, cacao, saline, toasted malt, dried grass.
Palate: Intense caramel, coffee bean, cacao, milk, salt, anise.

name: Odd Society Bittersweet Vermouth 375 ml
description: A new world rendition of an old French recipe from the late 1800's.  We infuse a Naramata Viognier blend with 25 exotic and locally foraged botanicals, including Arbutus bark from Mayne Island.  Fortified with our neutral spirit, sweetened with caramelized sugar.  Drink before dinner on ice with an orange slice/olive to stimulate your appetite or in your favourite vermouth cocktail.Nose:  Dried Italian herb, citrus zest, bright, floral, astrigent, caramel, vanilla, musk.Palate:  Opens sweet & fruity, floral, orange, turns herbal with damp tree bark, ends in a long, bitter wormwood finish, while remaining sweet like nectar. Awards:Silver (Amaro or Vermouth)- Canadian Artisan Spirit Competition 2023Gold (with distinction)+Best in Class (Amaro or Vermouth) Cdn Artisan Spirit Competition 2022

name: Odd Society Crème de Cassis 375 ml
description: A classic French liqueur made from black currants. Odd Society's Crème de Cassis is based on the secret recipe of friend and Master Chef, Hervé Martin.  We are honoured to partner with Hervé to produce this French classic made with the finest BC-grown black currants.  The best of Europe and BC in one bottle.Fruity and sweet balanced by a crisp acidity, a premium liqueur for discerning bar programs.

name: Odd Society Mia Amata Amaro 375 ml
description:
Amaro, meaning bitter in Italian, is a bittersweet herbaceous liqueur, defined by the harmony of botanicals which comprise every unique recipe. Ours is a family secret, created by Mia Glanz, the
daughter of the distiller. 
It began as a wish to create a liqueur with two Brazilian aphrodisiac botanicals, and evolved into a rich, intense after-dinner sipper, in the tradition of all Italian Amari.

description: Limited edition Maple Rye Whisky. name: Odd Society Elderflower Liqueur 375 ml

name: Odd Society Salal Gin 375 ml
description: We created our Salal Gin in the tradition of sloe gin using an abundant Pacific Northwest berry.  Salal berries are steeped in Wallflower Gin for weeks until the berry flavour and colour are deep and rich.  This creates a unique liqueur that is complex, sweet, tart and herbaceous.  On the nose, aromas of blueberry, caramel and lemon are met with a natural hint of oregano.On the palate, there is earthy blueberry and spice with sweet licorice.

name: Odd Society Maple Canadian Single Malt Whisky 375 ml

The distilled spirit is then aged for a minimum of three winters in oak casks that were previously used to age maple syrup.Robust, with slight smoke and a touch of silky maple sweetness this whisky is warm and rich enough to see you through a long cold winter.46% ABV

Infused with fragrant west-coast and international botanicals, this beguiling spirit boasts fresh and juicy strawberry notes that complement its signature citrus and floral profile.
Sweet on the nose and tart on the palate, this gin is exquisite in cocktails and makes a lovely addition to your favourite tonic.

name: Odd Society Boneyard Anniversary Whisky 750 ml
description: Boneyard is a very special, limited release to celebrate Odd Society's tenth anniversary.  In a unique nod to the "Solera" method, we save several litres from every whisky bottling and age them in two special casks, which we called our Boneyard  Casks.  The whisky is a natural blend of single malt, maple whisky, peated malt, rye and smoked malt.  The oldest addition is over seven years old and the youngest four and a half.  Odd Society has saved several litres from this release and started another Boneyard Barrel.The whisky itself is wonderfully unique, complex and balanced.Tasting Note:  caramel, vanilla, chocolatey orange, musk and leather, marzipan, nougat, hint of smoke  with a dry finish.

name: Odd Society Robbie Burns Whisky 750 ml
description:
Odd Society is releasing its second whisky in honour of Robbie Burns. Scotland's national poet is known the world over for his work which centered on universal themes such as love and nature.
This release was aged for five years in once-used, American white oak, ex-rye barrels. It is a deliciously light, easy-sipping dram that is bright, smoky, and peaty with caramelized honey and straw on the nose. The palate has rich honey notes, chewy nut brittle, and a slightly spicy, mineral briny salinity. The whisky ends with a clean woodfire smoke finish. A beautiful tribute to an enduring master of words..

name: Odd Society Port Barrel-Aged Gin 375 ml

Over time, each barrel contributes its own unique port flavours.  We then combined the barrels for a one-of-a-kind blend.The gin begins with notes of prune and stewed fruit with underlying strawberry and cherry flavours.  There is also a candied citrus undertone along with dried cranberries and raisins, reminiscent of fruit leather.  It has a very long rich finish that is bold, yet soothing and refined.

name: Odd Society Garryana Oak Whisky 375 ml
description:
This whisky includes malt that has been smoked with Garry wood, the only Oak species native to BC.
Tobacco smoke on the nose and a rich, buttery mouthfeel.  The flavour is reminiscent of burnt brown sugar sweetness and graham cracker biscuity flavour.
Aged four years in once-used American White Oak barrels.
