name: Sea Star 2024 Ortega
description:
100% Ortega grapes came from Sea Star's vineyard at Clam Bay Farm. Grapes were destemmed, crushed, pressed andcold settled. After fermentation in 100% stainless steel, the wine was left on its fine lees to addtexture before being racked and bottled.

 

This varietal is sought after for its bright, floral bouquet and crisp acidity. Light and refreshing, made from our island’s Ortega grapes, the varietal is on full display in this wine. Flavours of tropical fruits and a crisp, clean finish make this a wine that
pairs perfectly with a variety of seafood dishes, spicy dishes like Thai green curry, Manchego cheese, or enjoyed on its own on the patio.
collection: Wine; White;Sea Star Vineyards; Gulf Islands

name: Sea Star 2024 Salish Sea
description: Coaxing out the best qualities of Ortega and Siegerrebe, our winemaker has captured the aromas of melon, pineapple and herbs. The bright acidity of this expressive and aromatic wine is balanced with a medley of tropical fruit flavours, creating an excellent partner to garden fresh vegetables and zesty salsas.
collection: Wine; White;Sea Star Vineyards; Gulf Islands

name: Sea Star 2024 Blanc de Noir
description: Crafted as a true “white from black,” Sea Star’s premium Blanc de Noir results from the gentlest handling of the fruit to ensure virtually no skin contact with the free running juice. This gravity extraction captures the delicate character of the supple vascular bundles of our Pinot Noir grapes.
collection: Wine; White;Sea Star Vineyards; Gulf Islands

name: Sea Star 2023 Luna Maris
description: Prosecco-style sparkling wine made from a blend of two different Pinot Blanc grapes. Luna Maris’ bright acidity is balanced with hints of brioche and a velvety depth.
collection: Wine; White;Sea Star Vineyards; Gulf Islands

name: Sea Star 2022 Chardonnay
description: Experience a unique take on this classic Burgundian varietal with Sea Star 2022 Chardonnay. Ours shines with bright acidity and pleasant, subtle oak character, complemented by tantalizing notes of green apple, pear, and toasted nuts on the palate. This exquisite Chardonnay pairs brilliantly with fatty Pacific Northwest salmon or poultry with butter and herbs, enhancing your dining experience with sophistication. Discover the perfect balance of tradition and innovation in every sip. Elevate your collection with Sea Star 2022 Chardonnay, where quality meets extraordinary craftsmanship.
collection: Wine; White;Sea Star Vineyards; Gulf Islands

name: Synchromesh 2023 Thorny Vines Riesling
description: About a third of the way up the Naramata Bench with a Northern aspect, the Thorny Vines property is lovingly cared for by the Hornby-Smiths. Reaching into slightly richer loamy soils, these vines bring palate weight and a linear acidity not seen from our other properties.  Citrus and mandarin explode on the nose leading to a very textured mouthfeel of tropical fruit and apple. A sweet kiss lifts the fruit until the Thorny Vines acidity wipes it clean to a nearly dry finish.

name: Synchromesh 2023 Long's View Riesling
description: The former Bob Hancock Vineyard has been renamed for the current owners Charles and Linda Long. Returning to vineyard ownership after many years, the Long’s have committed to a fully organic transition of this property as we nurture it into maturity. Located up above the Naramata Village on an alluvial fan of mostly calcium carbonate, the gentle southern slope provides very even and balanced ripening with great acid retention and gentle structure.

name: Synchromesh 2017 Riesling Black Label Storm Haven Vineyard
Synchromesh 2022 Storm Haven Blue Label Gibson Block 3 Riesling
Synchromesh 2022 Storm Haven Blue Label Gold Digger Riesling
Synchromesh 2023 Storm Haven White Label Riesling
description: Storm Haven vineyard is the 107 acre home and heart of Synchromesh. With large elevation changes and varying geology, we are able explore very different expressions of Riesling from each block. This wine comprises fermentations from Block 3, Gibson Block, Boulders and Gold Digger.

name: Synchromesh 2023 Riesling Blend
description: A thoughtful blend of the Four Riesling vineyards: Long’s View Vineyard, Thorny Vines Vineyard, Four Shadows Vineyard and Storm Haven Vineyard in Okanagan Falls.

name: Synchromesh 2022 Storm Haven Cabernet Franc
description:
Storm Haven Vineyard is the 107-acre home and heart of Synchromesh. With large elevation changes and varying geology, we are able to explore very different expressions of Riesling, Cabernet Franc and Pinot Noir from each block. Farmed without synthetics or chemicals and following a holistic approach, we strive to grow our vines within the existing ecosystem rather than manipulating it. All this is supported by a 65 acre sanctuary to protect the sensitive habitat that calls our property home.

 

The Storm Haven Label represents the pinnacle of wines from this property in a given year.

name: Synchromesh 2017 Cabernet Franc Turtle Rock Farms
Synchromesh 2016 Merlot Turtle Rock Farms
description: From a single vineyard on a granite / gravel base above the Naramata Bench, this merlot is dark and broodingly dense with roasted coffee, walnuts, and inky cassis. The palate is plush, and the tannins softened, though the wood striation is still very noticeable and upfront. Lots going on here; one to lay down for a few more years. Treve Ring - Gismondi On Wine

name: Synchromesh 2022 Storm Haven 'Blue Label' Pinot Noir
Synchromesh 2022 Tertre Rouge Story Orchard Farms
description: This is a single vineyard wine from Story Orchard Farms above the Naramata Bench that we have been farming since 2011 (formerly known as Turtle Rock Farms). This stunning property has perfect conditions for long slow ripening of Cabernet Franc and Merlot. Aged for 16 months in French Oak with 28% new barrels, bottled without fining or filtration this is a blend of Merlot (51%) and Cabernet Franc (49%).

name: Unsworth Charme de l’île Rosé
description: The rosé counterpart to our flagship Charme de l’île is crafted from 100% Pinot Noir.

name: Unsworth 2023 Chardonnay
description:
Cowichan Valley Chardonnay

Aromas of lemon, yellow apple and blanched almonds on the nose lead to vibrant citrus and apple notes on the palate. Coy in its youth, this wine will continue to develop complexity with 3-5 years in the cellar.

name: Unsworth 2021 Sauvignette
description: This rather unique Vancouver Island grape variety has fantastic texture due to neutral French oak barrel fermentation and aging. White peach and grapefruit aromas on the palate lead to vibrant Key lime and pear flavours with notes of salty ocean air. Aged on fine lees in barriques for 6 months

name: Unsworth 2024 Pinot Gris
description:
Cowichan Valley Pinot Gris

 

Cowichan Valley’s most planted white grape is a hallmark Unsworth Vineyards white wine. This wine is dry and poised with flavours of lime sherbet, pear, and green apple.

 

Fermentation: 90% stainless steel, 10% neutral French oak

name: Unsworth 2024 Pinot Gris - Keg
description: Vancouver Island’s most planted white grape is a hallmark Unsworth wine. This wine is dry and poised with flavours of lemon curd, pear, and green apple.Fermented in 90% Stainless Steel and 10% neutral barriques
collection: Vancouver Island; White;Unsworth Vineyards; Keg; Wine

name: Unsworth 2024 Pinot Gris "Saison Vineyard"
description:
Saison Vineyard Pinot Gris

 

We wanted to celebrate the special terroir of Saison, thus decided to make this single vineyard Pinot Gris. It is dry and bright on the palate with a great breadth of flavour and even more vibrant notes of salinity, ripe citrus, and apple.

Fermentation: 90% stainless steel, 10% neutral French oak

name: Unsworth 2022 Petit Milo
description: Petit Milo, considering our cool climate, shows surprisingly ripe flavours of apricot, white peach and green papaya. Due to its small berries and thick skins, it is packed full of flavour to accompany its wonderful texture. Armed with a crisp finish, Petit Milo brings an exotic flair perfect for a wide array of food.

name: Unsworth 2022 Auxerrois "Wild Island"
description: Dry with round mouthfeel and ripe orchard fruit aromas. Auxerrois was once under-appreciated but is now enjoying a resurgence of popularity in BC.Ripe melon and windfall yellow apples fill the bouquet on the nose. On the palate this wine is dry with medium body supported by soft acidity and notes of cantaloupe, lilies and yellow apple.

name: Unsworth 2018 Gamay Noir / Pinot Noir - Keg
collection: Vancouver Island;Unsworth Vineyards; Keg; Red; Wine

name: Unsworth 2024 Rosé
description: Dry and fruit forward on the palate, Unsworth Rosé is purpose made 100% Pinot Noir. Aromas of strawberry and raspberry give way to flavours of cranberry and notes of rhubarb.Most associated with the summer months, rosé can add sunshine to every season.

name: Unsworth 2022 Pinot Noir "Cowichan Valley"
description:
Cowichan Valley Pinot Noir

With aromas of opulent red fruit, violets, and baking spice on the nose, the palate continues to impress revealing notes of cherries, wild berries and notes of fall forest. Bright mouthfeel and velvety tannins add to the layers of complexity

name: Unsworth 2023 Symphony "Island Red Blend"
description:
Symphony is a deliciously unique Vancouver Island wine. Aromas of cherry, tobacco leaf and cedar box on the nose reveal flavours of Bing cherry, plum, spices, and charcoal on the palate. This wine is dry, well structured, and versatile with an array of cuisine.

 

Varieties:  Cabernet Libre, Labelle, Corivese

name: Unsworth 2021 Symphony - Island Red Blend - Keg
description: Wild berries, currants, dried tobacco and notes of coastal forests on the nose give way to structured tannins, cherries and exotic spices on the palate. Symphony is a blend of Cabernet Libre, Labelle and small percentages of other sparsely planted varieties unique to Vancouver Island.
collection: Vancouver Island;Unsworth Vineyards; Keg; Red; Wine

name: Unsworth Vineyards 2023 Rosé Keg
collection: Vancouver Island;Unsworth Vineyards; Keg; Rosé; Wine

name: Unsworth Vineyards 2022 Pinot Noir Keg
description: Selected from the best hillside blocks from our vineyards, the Pinot Noir fruit that is destined for red wine is handled with the utmost care consistent with premium Pinot Noir production around the globe. Volumes are low to keep quality high. A light and vibrant expression of coastal Pinot Noir with a depth of flavour and complexity that impresses the most discerning of drinker. Aromas of cherry, dried strawberry with notes of dried leaves and subtle spice are complimented by flavours of dark cherry hallmark to Vancouver Island Pinot Noir.
collection: Vancouver Island;Unsworth Vineyards; Keg; Red; Wine

name: Unsworth Vineyards 2020 Island Melody
description: This fun, quaffable white wine blend of Pinot Gris (49%), Amiel (16%), Sauvignette (14%) Petit Milo (11%), Bachus (6%), Auxerrois (4%) . Fruit and floral aromatics give way to a pleasing and smooth mid palate and long finish.

name: Unsworth Charme de l'île
description: A vibrant blend of mostly Pinot Gris, Pinot Noir with a smattering of other cool climate grape varieties. Made in the Charmat Method of sparkling wine production, Charme is our local alternative to Prosecco. It is fruit forward on the nose and dry on the palate resulting in a quintessential island bubble!

name: Wayward Distillery Unruly Vodka 375ml
description: Unruly Vodka starts life as 100% pure BC Honey. We gently ferment our honey into mead and distill that mead into vodka using custom designed stills to separate out the harsh heads and the oily tails, ensuring that only the softest and sweetest hearts are ever collected.

name: Wayward Distillery Unruly Gin 750ml
description:
Unruly Gin starts life as 100% pure BC Honey. We gently ferment our honey into mead and distill that mead to spirit using custom designed stills to separate out the harsh heads and the oily tails, ensuring that only the softest and sweetest hearts are ever collected. We then distill those hearts one final time, using vapour infusion to capture the delicate and bright aromas of our unique blend of locally sourced and organic botanicals.
Juniper with a hint of cedar and citrus, a dash of fragrant lavender and sarsaparilla root, and the vibrant notes of coriander.

name: Wayward Distillery Char #3 - Barrel Aged Gin 375ml
description:
When a gin and bourbon love each other very much you end up with Wayward's - Char #3. This unlikely union between our honey-based Unruly Gin and the inside of a charred bourbon barrel captures the best from both worlds.
Six months in the barrel balances earthy citrus against aromatic toasted vanilla and finishes up this spirit with some long, lingering spice. This is an unexpected gin for the unrepentant bourbon lover!

name: Wayward Distillery Raspberry Gin Liqueur 375ml
description:
This bright & refreshing Raspberry Gin Liqueur will be your best friend all year.
Like the saying goes: when life gives you raspberries, you crush the hell out of them, add a touch of raw honey and blend them together into premium gin - obviously.

name: Wayward Distillery Raspberry Gin Liqueur 750ml

name: Wayward Distillery Krupnik - Spiced Honey Liqueur 375ml
description: Before you open this bottle, Wayward would like to take this opportunity to apologize. We are about to ruin your drinking life with this golden-hued, Polish gem of a honey spirit called Krupnik. Often compared to cinnamon whisky or spiced rum, Krupnik is a spirit in a category all its own. To save yourself from this addictive blend of toasted honey, cinnamon, nutmeg, raw vanilla and citrus peel it should NEVER be mixed with sparkling apple cider, ginger beer, chai tea, or hot water and lemon. And never you mind that favourite flask...Once you have opened this you won't be able to stop and we're sorry.So sorry.

name: Wayward Distillery Cortes Island Apple Brandy - Cask Strength 375ml
description: It's like Calvados, only cask strength and made from heritage apples grown on Cortes Island! Harvested in 2018, this apple brandy was aged almost 3 years in a single whisky cask. This is not your grammy’s brandy. This is bold, spicy and resinous with apple sauce and custard and an overabundance of personality. In other words, just the way we like it!

name: Wayward Distillery Depth Charge Espresso & Cacao Bean Vodka Infusion 375ml
description:
Rebuilt and Reimagined for 2022!
Wayward Distillery runs on coffee. We love it. Some say we need it.
Depth Charge Vodka Infusion is the embodiment of everything we love about coffee: it's deep, dark, nutty and delicious! Instead of cold brewing on water, we cold brew espresso beans and cacao beans on our super smooth vodka, capturing all the complex coffee aromas and real dark chocolate flavours. It's then finished with just a drop of our own honey to tie it all together.

name: Wayward Distillery Comox Valley Apple Brandy - Cask Strength 375ml
description:
It's like Calvados, only cask strength and made from heritage cider apples grown on the banks of the Tsolum River in the Comox Valley!
Harvested in 2019, this apple brandy was aged almost 3 years in a single Drunken Hive Rum cask. This is not your grammy’s brandy. This is bold, spicy and resinous with apple sauce and custard and an overabundance of personality. In other words, just the way we like it!
375ml / 61.45%

name: Wayward Distillery Char #3 - Barrel Aged Gin - Rum Edition 375ml
description: We aged our signature 100% fermented from honey Unruly Gin in the cozy embrace of our award-winning Drunken Hive Rum barrels for 8 tasty months, yielding a softer and sweeter profile than traditional Char #3. The juniper takes a backseat as tropical fruit, root beer, vanilla pudding, candied orange, and caramelized molasses confidently steal the spotlight.

name: Wayward Distillery Bee Champion Craft Gin 750ml
description: Opening: Embrace the bold, piney freshness of juniper and locally harvested spruce tips.Mid-Palate: Citrus undertones with hints of spruce tip, balanced by lemon and orange peel and a dash of lemongrass.Top Note: Floral and slightly fruity, yet restrained from being overly perfumy. With lavender, rose, rosehip (reminiscent of strawberry fruit leather) and subtle violet.Complexity: A subtle hint of brine, courtesy of Rosemary and Cucumber peelFinish: Smooth vanilla from sarsaparilla root leaves a pleasant, lingering aftertaste.

name: Wayward Distillery Unruly Vodka 750ml
description: Unruly Vodka starts life as 100% pure BC Honey. We gently ferment our honey into mead and distill that mead into vodka using custom designed stills to separate out the harsh heads and the oily tails, ensuring that only the softest and sweetest hearts are ever collected.Hint of vanilla on the palate are what make this vodka stand out. The incredibly smooth finish and uncompromising dedication to the highest quality of spirit are what sets Unruly Vodka apart.

name: Wayward Distillery Depth Charge - Celiac Safe Version 375ml
description: Welcome to the delightful collaboration between a small local coffee roastery and Wayward’s award winning Unruly Vodka. We cold brew a custom blend of organic fair trade espresso and raw organic cacao nibs with our Unruly Vodka to achieve dark and dry perfection.

name: Unsworth 2024 Allegro "Island White Blend"
description: Aromas of ripe peach, green papaya, and soft floral notes on the nose, which leads to a bright mid palate and refreshing length. This unique and hyperlocal blend of Petit Milo and Sauvignette is a true Vancouver Island hallmark.
collection: Unsworth Vineyards; Vancouver Island; White; Wine
